bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; ot_hgi_coll_tkm_seq #(.KMAX(2048), .DEL(4), .FW(512), .PWT(545), .CAP(64), .MUT(0)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/tkm/ot_hgi_coll_tkm_cluster.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_relay.sv rtl/hbm_accel/tu/ot_hcoll_sram_prims.sv rtl/hbm_accel/ha2_ar/ot_ha2_prims.sv physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2_bb.v physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2_bb.v && echo lint-ok

bench.name: tkm_cluster_exact
bench.cmd: python3 tools/hgi_coll_tkm_vectors.py --out {RUN}/vec && TKM_CLUSTER=1 J=8 bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/tkm/run_tkm_bench.sh {RUN}/bench/positive {RUN}/vec quick && grep -q "HGI_TKM PASS" {RUN}/bench/positive/SUMMARY

bench.name: tkm_cluster_noid_mutant
bench.cmd: python3 tools/hgi_coll_tkm_vectors.py --out {RUN}/vec_mut && TKM_CLUSTER=1 J=8 bash rtl/hbm_accel/generic/collective/tkm/run_tkm_bench.sh {RUN}/bench/noid {RUN}/vec_mut mut 4 && grep -q "HGI_TKM PASS" {RUN}/bench/noid/SUMMARY

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/hbm_tkm_seq_probe2240/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/hbm_tkm_seq_probe2240/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/hbm_tkm_seq_probe2240 --out {RUN}/record/views/ot_hgi_coll_tkm_seq --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_1024x256_m2_r2c2 --macro-view physical/asap7_memory_macros/ot_sram_1r1w_128x256_m1_r2c2 > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1
